profile.summary: Final year Computer Engineering student at D.J. Sanghvi College of Engineering, Mumbai (CGPA: 8.67). Experienced in building production agentic AI systems with LangGraph, distributed microservices with Spring Boot & RabbitMQ, and high-impact web and mobile apps.
profile.status: Actively looking for Software Engineering & AI Internships / Full-Time Roles

personal_facts.fact: Final year Computer Engineering student at D.J. Sanghvi College of Engineering, Mumbai with an honors track in Data Science (CGPA: 8.67).
Massive cricket fan. Die-hard Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) supporter in IPL (still backing Ee Sala Cup Namde with pure ironic faith every season).
Passionate football enthusiast. Supports Atletico Madrid in La Liga; absolute favorite footballer is Antoine Griezmann.
Loves sitcoms and dramas: How I Met Your Mother, The Office (US), Modern Family, Brooklyn 99, Parks and Recreation, Breaking Bad, and Better Call Saul.
Hard rock and classic rock fan: Linkin Park, Guns N' Roses, Queen, and Metallica. Considers Bohemian Rhapsody and November Rain absolute works of art.
Loves late-night long drives around Mumbai, experimenting with new tech, and eating good food (though a self-confessed picky eater).
Passionate about autonomous agent architectures, distributed fault-tolerant microservices, high-throughput message queues, and clean UI engineering.
